crossRefs.note: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.
As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him…
God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and…
I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of…
These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute…
Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

translations.web: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.
translations.bsb: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will descend from you.
translations.kjv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out
translations.asv: And I will make thee exceeding fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
